questions.question: A person loses 20%, when he sells a watch for Rs. 2,300. What is his profit percentage if he sells it for Rs. 3,231.50?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Loss Percentage = 20%

Initial Selling Price = Rs. 2,300

New Selling Price = Rs. 3,231.50

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 20% = 1/5

⇒ 4 = 2300

⇒ 1 = 575

⇒ 5 = 2300 + 575 = 2875

⇒ Profit = SP - CP = 3231.50 - 2875 = 356.5

⇒ Profit% = (356.5/2875) × 100 = 12.4

∴ The Profit% when the watch is sold at Rs. 3,231.50 is 12.4%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Formula Used:**

Loss% = {(CP – SP)/CP} × 100

Profit% = {(SP – CP)/CP} × 100 

where SP = Selling Price and CP = Cost Price

**Calculation:**

Loss% = {(CP – SP)/CP} × 100

⇒ 20 = (CP – 2300)/CP × 100

⇒ 20/100 × CP = CP – 2,300

⇒ 80/100 × CP = 2,300

⇒ CP = (2300 × 100)/80

⇒ CP = 2875

So, Cost Price of the watch is Rs. 2,875

New Selling Price is Rs. 3,231.50

So, Profit% = {(SP – CP)/CP} × 100

⇒ {(3231.50 – 2875)/2875} × 100

⇒ (356.5/2875) × 100

⇒ 12.4

**∴ The Profit% when the watch is sold at Rs. 3,231.50 is 12.4%**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

Let the CP of watch be x

As, there is 20% loss. So, 80% of x = 2300

⇒ x = 2300 × 100/80

⇒ x = 2875

Now, New SP = Rs. 3231.5

So, SP/CP = 3231.5/2875

⇒ SP/CP = 1.124

Here, the Selling Price is 1.124 times of Cost Price. So, SP is 12.4% more than CP.

**∴ The Profit% when the watch is sold at Rs.3,231.50 is 12.4%**

questions.question: The perimeter of a circular fields is 1012 m. The area of this field is equal to a rectangular garden whose sides are in the ratio 14 ∶ 11. The longer side of the garden is∶ (Take π =dfrac{22}{7})
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of circular fields is 1012 m.

The ratio of the sides of the rectangular garden is 14 ∶ 11

The area of this field is equal to a rectangular garden.

**Formula used:**

The perimeter of a circle = 2πr

Area of a circle = πr² 

Area of a rectangle = length × breadth

**Calculation:**

The perimeter of the circular field is 1012 m.

So, we can say 2πr = 1012 m

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × r = 1012 m

⇒ r = (23 × 7) m

Now, the area of the circular field = πr² 

⇒ πr² = 22/7 × (23 × 7)² m² 

⇒ (22 × 23 × 23 × 7) m² 

Let the length of the rectangular garden be 14x and breadth be 11x

So, the area of a rectangular garden is 14x × 11x

Now, the area of this field is equal to the rectangular garden

⇒ 14 × 11 × x² = (22 × 23 × 23 × 7) m² 

⇒ x² = (23 × 23) m² 

⇒ x = 23 m

Now, the longer side of the length of the rectangular park is (23 × 14) m

⇒ 322 m

**∴**** The longer side of the rectangular park is 322 m.**

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 10 hours and 13(1)/(3) hours, respectively. Pipe C is an emptying pipe. When all three pipes are opened together, the tanks is filled in 8 hours. Pipe C alone can empty 60% part of the tank in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe A is 10 hours

Time taken by Pipe B is 13(1)/(3)= (40/3) hours

Time taken by all pipe (A, B, C) together is 8 hours 

**Concept Used:**

When two pipes A and B can fill the tank in x, y hours respectively.

There is also an outlet pipe C. If all three pipes opened simultaneously tank will fill in z hours,

then the time taken by Pipe C to empty the full tank is given by

Time taken by Pipe C = (X × Y × Z)/(XZ + YZ - XY)

**Calculation:**

Let time taken by Pipe A, B and Pipe (A, B, C) together be denoted by X, Y and and Z respectively.

⇒ Time taken by Pipe C = [10 × (40/3) × 8]/[(10 × 8) + (40/3 × 8) - (10 × 40/3)]

⇒ Time taken by pipe C = (3200/3)/(160/3)

⇒ Time taken by Pipe C = 20 hours 

Time taken by Pipe C to empty 60% of the tank will be 60% of 20 hours

⇒ 60% of 20 hours

⇒ (60/100) × 20

⇒ 60/5

⇒ 12 hours

**∴** **The time taken by Pipe C to empty 60% of tank is 12 hours.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs.8,000 amounts to Rs.13,824 in 3 years at R% p.a., interest compound annually. What will it amount to in 1dfrac{1}{4} years at the same rate, if the interest is compounded half-yearly?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The principal is Rs. 8,000

The amount after 3 years compounded annually at R% p.a. is Rs. 13,824

**Formula used:**

Amount = Principal (1 + Rate/100)time

**Calculations:**

The principal is Rs. 8,000

The amount after 3 years compounded annually at R% p.a. is Rs. 13,824

Amount = Principal (1 + Rate/100)time

⇒ 13824 = 8000 (1 + R/100)³

⇒ 13824/8000 = (1 + R/100)³ 

⇒ sqrt[3]{{frac{{13824}}{{8000}}}} = 1 + (R/100)

⇒ 24/20 = 1 + R/100

⇒ 24/20 – 1 = R/100

⇒ R = 4/20 × 100

⇒ R = 20%

The compound interest when rate is compounded half-yearly for 1(1)/(4) years

First, Amount for 1 year

⇒ Time = 2 × 1 = 2 years

⇒ Rate = 20/2 = 10%

Amount = Principal (1 + Rate/100)time

⇒ Amount = 8000 (1+ 10/100)²

⇒ Amount = 8000 × (11/10) × (11/10)

⇒ Amount = 9680

Now, Simple Interest for 1/4 year

⇒ Time = 6 Months = 1 Year

⇒ 1/4 Year = 3 Months = 1/2 Year (Compounded half yearly)

⇒ Rate = 20/2 = 10%

Simple interest = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100

⇒ Simple interest = (9680 × (1/2) × 10)/100

⇒ Simple interest = 484

⇒ Total amount = Amount (1 year) + Simple interest (1/4 year)

⇒ Total amount = 9680 + 484

⇒ Total amount = 10164

**∴**** The total amount received after 1(1)/(4) ****years compounded half-yearly is Rs. 10,164**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 sqrt[3]{{frac{{Amount}}{{Principal}}}} = 1 + (R/100) 

⇒ sqrt[3]{{frac{{13824}}{{8000}}}} = 1 + (R/100)

⇒ 24/20 = 1 + R/100

⇒ R = 20%

The compound interest can also find by successive method.

Rate for compounded half-yearly is R/2 = 10%

⇒ Rate for 2 year is = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100 = 21%

⇒ Rate for 2 year is 21%

And,

⇒ Rate for 1/4 years is (1/4) × 20 = 5%

⇒ Final rate = 21 + 5 + (21 × 5)/100 = 27.05%

⇒ Amount = 127.05% of 8000

⇒ Amount = 10164

∴ The total amount received after 1(1)/(4) years compounded half-yearly is Rs. 10,164

questions.question: In a division action, the divisor is 8 times the quotient and 9 times the remainder. If the remainder is 24, what will the dividend be?
questions.solution:
**Given **

Remainder = 24 

**Formula Used **

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder 

**Calculation **

Divisor = 9 × 24 = 216 

Quotient = Divisor/8 = 216/8 = 27 

Dividend = 216 × 27 + 24 = 5856 

**∴ The required answer is 5,856**

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 5808 after 2 years and to Rs. 7,320 after 5 years at the same rate percent per annum at simple interest. What will be the simple interest on a sum of Rs. 8,500 for 4dfrac{2}{3} years at the same rate?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amounts after 2 years = Rs. 5808

Amounts after 5 years = Rs. 7320

Rate of interest is same in both cases.

**Formula used:**

P = A – S.I

A = P + S.I

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

R = (S.I × 100)/(P × T)

Where P = Principal, A = Amount, S.I = Simple Interest,

R = Rate of interest, T = Time period

**Calculation:**

Amounts after 5 years - Amounts after 2 years = 7320 - 5808

⇒ (P + S.I₅) - (P + S.I₂) = 1512

⇒ P + (P × R × 5)/100 - P - (P × R × 2)/100 = 1512

⇒ [(P × R)/100](5 - 2) = 1512

⇒ (P × R × 3)/100 = 1512

⇒ (P × R × 2)/100 = 1512 × (2/3)

⇒ (P × R × 2)/100 = 1008

Interest in 2 years = Rs. 1008

Interest in 1 year = Rs. (1008/2)

⇒ Rs. 504

Principal = Amount – S.I

⇒ Rs. 5808 - Rs. 1008

⇒ Rs. 4800

R = (S.I × 100)/(P × T)

⇒ (504 × 100)/(4800 × 1)

⇒ 504/48

⇒ 21/2%

Now P = 8500, R = 21/2%, T = 4(2)/(3) years = 14/3 years

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ [8500 × (21/2) × (14/3)]/100

⇒ (8500 × 21 × 14)/(100 × 2 × 3)

⇒ (85 × 21 × 14)/6

⇒ 4165

∴ The simple interest on a sum of Rs.8,500 for 4(2)/(3) years at the rate of (21/2)% will be Rs. 4165.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Amounts after 2 years = Rs. 5808

And Amounts after 5 years = Rs. 7320

Then Interest in 3 years = Amounts after 5 years - Amounts after 2 years

⇒ Rs. 7320 – Rs. 5808

⇒ Rs. 1512

Interest in 1 year = Rs. (1512/3)

⇒ Rs. 504

Interest in 2 years = Rs. (504 × 2)

⇒ Rs. 1008

Principal = Amount – S.I

⇒ Rs. 5808 - Rs. 1008

⇒ Rs. 4800

R = (S.I × 100)/(P × T)

⇒ (504 × 100)/(4800 × 1)

⇒ 504/48

⇒ 21/2%

Now P = 8500, R = 21/2%, T = 4(2)/(3) years = 14/3 years

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ [8500 × (21/2) × (14/3)]/100

⇒ (8500 × 21 × 14)/(100 × 2 × 3)

⇒ (85 × 21 × 14)/6

⇒ 4165

**∴ The simple interest on a sum of Rs.8,500 for 4(2)/(3) years at the rate of (21/2)% will be Rs. 4165.**

questions.question: The income of x is 80% more than of y, and the income of z is 60% of the total income of x and y. By how much percentage the income of z is less than the income of x (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Income of x = 80% more than of y

Income of z = 60% of the total income of x and y

**Concept used:**

Percentage of income of z is less than income of x,

⇒ [(x – z)/x] × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the income of y be 100 and income of x be 180 respectively(80% more than y).

And the income of z is 168 that is 60% of the total income of x and y

Percentage of income of z is less than income of x,

⇒ [(180 - 168)/180] × 100

⇒ [12/180] × 100

⇒ 6.7%

**∴ Income of z is 6.7% less than the income of x .**
